digest.component_or_area: LLM provider factory and session management
propositions: Provider construction is currently an inline special case in runner.py:268 with anthropic-specific branching logic that does not scale to multiple providers
Client lifecycle (httpx.AsyncClient) is managed ad-hoc via tuple unpacking and finally-block teardown in runner.py:446-452, with no abstraction for resource ownership

A ProviderSession object must own provider construction via a provider_factory callable matching pydantic-ai's infer_model hook signature, and must manage closeable resource lifecycle through context manager exit
Existing anthropic provider construction must move to a builder function registered in ProviderSession, preserving tenacity transport, max_retries=0, and per-request timeout behavior unchanged
Tests importing _build_retrying_anthropic_model directly must update their import site from rebar.llm.runner to rebar.llm.anthropic_model, and full test suite must pass with no behavior change
